source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Combat parses
summary: Sinister Strike to build combo points, keep Slice and Dice rolling at all times, maintain Rupture, Eviscerate as the dump finisher. Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush on cooldown.

Backstab.note: dagger/behind combo builder - Combat uses Sinister Strike, wrong spec or action bar

Mutilate.note: Assassination combo builder - wrong spec for a Combat build

Hemorrhage.note: Subtlety combo builder - wrong spec for Combat

breakpoint.note: Slice and Dice uptime is the single most important metric for Combat - it should be up nearly 100% of the fight after the opener. Sinister Strike should be the dominant spell after auto attacks. Rupture adds sustained bleed damage and should maintain high uptime.

advisory: Combat (Swords/Maces) is the dominant TBC raid rogue spec. Slice and Dice must never drop - refreshing it at 1 stack is fine. Adrenaline Rush doubles energy regeneration for 15s and should be used on cooldown. Blade Flurry adds a second swing for 15s - excellent on multi-target. Expose Armor (if assigned by raid leader) replaces one Eviscerate every 30s. Fight notes: time Blade Flurry with Adrenaline Rush onto cleave windows - Illidari Council, Hydross add waves, and Gurtogg/Najentus packs - rather than burning it on single-target. On positioning fights like Lady Vashj and Kael where uptime drops, protect Slice and Dice and Rupture first, and swap to Aspect-style sustain by pooling energy before forced movement so you re-enter melee mid-cycle.
